name: CaseFocusRingReservationTransparent
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "focus-ring-reservation-transparent" (interaction-states). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: THE FOCUS-RING RESERVATION IDIOM under a state that changes only the WIDTH: the rest plane is `outline: 2px solid transparent` (a real, drawn `outline-style: solid` over a fully transparent colour) and `:focus-visible` sets `outline-width: 4px`
